translations.web: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
translations.bsb: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
translations.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
